# Synthetic first-consultation test set

Fictional first consultations (before any agreement is signed) between Halyard Buyers Advocacy, a small, fictional Brisbane buyers agency, and prospective clients. Every person, agency and business is invented. Suburb and street names are real, but no property is identified by a numbered address.

| File | Setting | Situation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `01-budget-revision-southside-family.vtt` | Zoom export. Renting family of four with a dog, buying a home to live in, looking in Brisbane's middle-ring south-east (Carina, Mansfield, Holland Park area). | 1 |
| `02-couple-disagree-inner-northwest.vtt` | Teams export. Unit-owning couple planning a family, buying a home to live in, inner north-west (Grange and Wilston versus Mitchelton and Gaythorne). | 2 |
| `03-broker-joins-first-home-north.vtt` | Zoom export. Renting first home buyer couple, buying a townhouse or small home to live in, northside around Chermside, Kedron and Stafford. Their broker joins part-way. | 3 |
| `04-relocating-family-bayside.txt` | Plain-text transcript with Speaker 1–4 labels. Sydney family relocating for work, buying a home to live in, Brisbane bayside and the Redlands (Wynnum, Manly, Wellington Point). | 4 |
| `05-agent-notes-after-call-downsizers-west.txt` | The agent's own notes typed after a phone consultation (not a transcript). Retired couple downsizing from Kenmore, buying a low-maintenance home to live in, western suburbs (Indooroopilly, Taringa, Toowong). | 5 |
| `06-investor-interstate-outer-ring.vtt` | Teams export. Melbourne couple buying their first investment property in Brisbane's outer ring (Moreton Bay, Logan and Ipswich). | 6 |
| `07-missed-out-saturday-auction-north.txt` | Plain-text transcript with Speaker 1–4 labels. Renting couple with a baby, buying a home to live in, inner north-east (Wavell Heights, Nundah, Northgate, Kalinga), with an auction days away. | 7 |

## Provenance

Entirely fictional test material for [Draft the synthetic consultation test set](https://github.com/Jp8617465-sys/real-estate-app/issues/56). Drafted on 7 November 2026 by a fresh-context agent that received only the setting and failure cases and never saw the extraction design. James reviewed the set for realism and accepted it unchanged. Deliberate automatic-transcription errors and evenly paced, script-generated timestamps are intentional. Prices and Queensland rules quoted by speakers are the drafter's estimates, not verified facts. Expected answers are added separately and are decided by James.
